module_summary: AXI-Stream-to-XGMII 64-bit transmitter: a 7-state FSM inserts preamble, pads, appends CRC32 FCS from eight parallel LFSRs, and enforces IFG with deficit-idle lane swapping.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD/PAD/FCS/ERR/IFG controller selecting XGMII output and tready

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI-Stream payload input masked by tkeep into data register

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid; starts frames and detects underflow

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready driven by FSM; gates accepted beats

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker moving FSM toward padding/FCS

anchors.name: s_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte enables converted to empty count for last word

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Bit0 marks bad frame forcing ERR state; also PTP tag source

anchors.name: xgmii_txd
anchors.why: 64-bit XGMII transmit data output

anchors.name: xgmii_txc
anchors.why: XGMII control lane flags output

anchors.name: xgmii_txd_reg
anchors.why: Registered XGMII output, optionally lane-swapped by 32 bits

anchors.name: xgmii_txd_next
anchors.why: FSM-selected output word: idle, preamble, payload, FCS or error

anchors.name: s_tdata_reg
anchors.why: One-beat payload delay feeding CRC LFSRs and XGMII output

anchors.name: s_empty_reg
anchors.why: Empty-byte count of last word; selects FCS placement and IFG offset

anchors.name: crc_state_reg
anchors.why: CRC32 states; entry 7 is running CRC, others per-byte-width results

anchors.name: reset_crc
anchors.why: Reinitialises running CRC in IDLE

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Advances running CRC during payload, pad and FCS

anchors.name: fcs_output_txd_0
anchors.why: Final data word merging tail bytes, inverted CRC and terminate

anchors.name: fcs_output_txd_1
anchors.why: Overflow FCS word when CRC spills into a second cycle

anchors.name: frame_min_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes to minimum frame length; drives PAD state

anchors.name: ifg_count_reg
anchors.why: Inter-frame gap countdown held in IFG state

anchors.name: deficit_idle_count_reg
anchors.why: Deficit idle count carried between frames for DIC

anchors.name: swap_lanes_reg
anchors.why: Selects 32-bit lane-shifted output to start frames in lane 4

anchors.name: swap_txd
anchors.why: Holds upper half word for lane-swapped output

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Inside-frame flag used to drop remaining beats and hold IFG

anchors.name: frame_error_reg
anchors.why: Frame error latched; routes PAD to ERR state

anchors.name: frame_start_reg
anchors.why: Start pulse triggering PTP timestamp capture and start_packet

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Configured inter-frame gap loaded into IFG count

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Transmit enable gating tready in IDLE

anchors.name: error_underflow
anchors.why: Pulses when tvalid drops mid-frame

anchors.name: start_packet
anchors.why: Start-of-packet indication with lane position

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts
anchors.why: Captured PTP timestamp output for transmitted frame

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts_valid
anchors.why: Valid pulse accompanying timestamp and tag

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts_reg
anchors.why: Timestamp latched at frame start, adjusted for lane swap

groups.name: TX FSM
groups.description: Sequences preamble, payload, padding, FCS, error and IFG phases

groups.name: Input datapath
groups.description: Masks input bytes and delays one beat with empty count

groups.name: CRC generator
groups.description: Eight LFSRs compute CRC per tail width; FCS words assembled

groups.name: Frame and IFG counters
groups.description: Minimum-length padding and inter-frame gap with deficit idle

groups.name: XGMII output lane swap
groups.description: Registers XGMII word, optionally shifting by four lanes

groups.name: PTP and status
groups.description: Start-of-frame timestamp capture, tag output and status pulses
